## Cross-Record Timeline

Merges events from ACROSS linked records — a case plus its replies, escalations, SLA pauses, tasks — into one stream; the CALLER merges (only it knows which cards relate), this component owns the drawing. DELIBERATELY DISTINCT from the Audit desk's Audit Timeline, which renders ONE subject's append-only Audit Entry trail; the two readMes cross-reference so nobody builds a third.

```gts
<CrossRecordTimeline @events={{this.events}} @emptyLabel='No escalations yet.' />
```

Each event is `{ at, label, by?, intent? }`; `intent` colours its marker.

The linked example shows a case desk's escalations as one stream.

### Non-goals

Not an audit trail and not append-only storage — it reads records, it stores nothing.
